import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotient
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Properties

/-!
# Integrality of geometric quotients

Injective pullback on sections descends reducedness. A geometric quotient of
an integral scheme is therefore integral, since its underlying continuous map
is surjective and irreducibility descends along continuous surjections.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
  {act : G →* Aut X} {q : X ⟶ Y} (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)

include hq

/-- The target of a geometric quotient of a reduced scheme is reduced. -/
theorem isReduced_target [AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced Y where
  component_reduced U := isReduced_of_injective (q.app U).hom (hq.app_injective U)

/-- The target of a geometric quotient of an integral scheme is integral. -/
theorem isIntegral_target [IsIntegral X] : IsIntegral Y := by
  letI : AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced Y := hq.isReduced_target
  letI : IrreducibleSpace Y :=
    Function.Surjective.irreducibleSpace q.continuous hq.isQuotientMap.surjective
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced Y

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient
